concept.title: The gates a draft passes
concept.shortdesc: A draft reaches a writer only after two schema gates and two checks. Code fixes what code can fix, and the model is asked again only about the fields that still fail.

dlentry.dd: The Gemini API must return JSON that matches a schema built for this topic and run. The schema lists only the keys, source IDs, reusable notes and conflicts that exist, and fixes the number of spec rows and table columns. checks the shape again in code, for every model.
A literal value that a key holds becomes the key reference. A title in title case becomes sentence case. The topic ID follows the house pattern.
The XML must be valid against the OASIS DITA 1.3 RELAX NG grammar, checked with lxml.
ISO Schematron rules from the corpus and from : spec values are keys, a table uses its siblings' header, every draft records its run.
Every number, unit, flag, command and key matches a fact, and every paragraph cites the sources it uses. GiB against GB fails.

conbody.p: When a field fails, the model revises only that field, up to times. A field that still fails becomes a question. A topic that fails the grammar after that is withheld.
